title: Protesters clash with police over Venezuela’s poor minimum wage
html:
Protesters clash with police over Venezuela's poor minimum wage

Labour organisers shared videos of police violently clashing with protesters near Venezuela’s Miraflores presidential palace, as they staged a demonstration over the country’s meagre minimum wages. Despite promised increases, they remain technically frozen at around $3 a month.
summary: Labour organisers shared videos of police violently clashing with protesters near Venezuela’s presidential palace.
